[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Fri 19:17): Landesparteitag der Linken | Marathon-Vorbereitung | Innovationspreis Brandenburg
item.description:
Originally published Fri 25 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Nach dem Wahlsieg vom vergangenen Sonntag berät am Abend die Berliner Linke auf einem Sonderparteitag, wie es weitergehen soll. Außerdem: Der geplante Tankrabatt wird Berlin laut Finanzverwaltung voraussichtlich rund 60 Millionen Euro kosten. Die Vorbereitungen für den Berlin-Marathon am Wochenende sind in vollem Gange. Und der Innovationspreis Brandenburg wird verliehen. "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 18:51): Rapid new test transforms brain tumour diagnosis
item.description:
Originally published Fri 25 Sep 2026 18:51 IDT.

A rapid new test for brain tumours can slash the time it takes for an accurate diagnosis from up to eight weeks to two hours. It means surgeons can get results even while they are operating, and patients are spared weeks of uncertainty whilst being able to start their treatment sooner. Also: Ukrainian President, Volodymyr Zelensky says that President Trump has made a “final decision” to give Ukraine licences to produce patriot missiles. Indonesia pardons a former Filipino maid, who was sentenced to death after being found carrying heroin through an airport. We hear the latest about the Ebola outbreak from a doctor who spent six weeks in Northern Congo. Nepal’s Prime Minister, Balendra Shah, says flooding in his country “was a warning to the world” and calls for cooperation to deal with climate change. An organisation in the United Kingdom says better regulation of beauty products is needed as young children continue to use skincare and makeup. And Pope Leo visits Paris for a mass, but his first engagement gives a warning about artificial intelligence and assisted dying.
